opportunities.title: IFAD Support for Food Systems Transformation in the Central Sahel
opportunities.eligibility: Eligible organisations able to implement a regional food-systems transformation initiative in Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger, subject to IFAD grant-financing requirements.
opportunities.supports: Catalytic seed financing for innovative and scalable interventions across livestock, cassava and rice value chains, including production, processing, marketing and consumption.
opportunities.contact: IFAD call-for-proposals contact listed on the official call page
opportunities.seo_title: IFAD Central Sahel Food Systems Transformation Grant
opportunities.seo_description: Official IFAD call for a USD 2 million regional grant supporting food systems transformation in Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger.

opportunities.title: IFAD Grant: Rural Sector Performance Assessment for Policy and Investment
opportunities.eligibility: Eligible recipient or consortium under the IFAD grant call and its published financing requirements; this is an institutional grant opportunity rather than a general farmer cash grant.
opportunities.supports: Leveraging IFAD's Rural Sector Performance Assessment for policy and investment, subject to the published call requirements.
opportunities.contact: IFAD call-for-proposals contact listed on the official call page
opportunities.seo_title: IFAD Rural Sector Performance Assessment Grant
opportunities.seo_description: Official IFAD grant call for rural-sector performance assessment work supporting policy and investment.

opportunities.title: Ghana REWARD Resilient Rice Value Chains Grant
target: Rice value-chain institutions and project beneficiaries
opportunities.eligibility: Participation is governed by the REWARD project implementation arrangements; this is a government project grant, not a general open cash-grant application.
opportunities.supports: Climate-resilient rice production, quality inputs and mechanization, irrigation and land development, rice processing, market linkages and private-sector participation.
opportunities.contact: African Development Bank Ghana Country Office / REWARD project implementation channels
opportunities.seo_title: Ghana REWARD Rice Value Chain Grant
opportunities.seo_description: Official AfDB information on the US$18.8 million REWARD grant for resilient rice value chains in Ghana.

opportunities.title: Sierra Leone Sustainable Agricultural Value-chains Intensification for Growth (SAVIG)
opportunities.eligibility: Project participation and support are governed by Sierra Leone's SAVIG implementation arrangements and targeted value chains; this is not a general unrestricted cash-grant application.
opportunities.supports: Agricultural value-chain productivity, private investment, post-harvest handling, processing, market linkages, access to finance and digital agriculture solutions.
opportunities.contact: World Bank Sierra Leone / SAVIG implementation channels
opportunities.seo_description: Official World Bank information on the US$40 million SAVIG agricultural value-chain grant in Sierra Leone.

opportunities.title: TAAT-III Africa Agricultural Technology Scaling Grant
opportunities.target_applicants: IITA and participating research institutions, governments, agribusiness and delivery partners under TAAT-III implementation
opportunities.eligibility: Institutional programme grant; not a general farmer cash-grant application.
opportunities.supports: Scaling proven climate-resilient agricultural technologies, seed systems, digital tools and partnerships across African Development Fund countries.
opportunities.deadline: Programme implementation grant; no public application deadline identified.
